title: Apache Kafka Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning an Apache Kafka distributed event-streaming instance

cluster_url.description: Target cluster server URL (optional, defaults to broker's cluster). Must be a registered ArgoCD cluster.

client_password.description: SASL/SCRAM password for the default Kafka client user (auto-generated if not provided)

inter_broker_password.description: SASL/SCRAM password for inter-broker communication (auto-generated if not provided)
